items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was at a meeting once and Grover, rest his soul… Grover was there and this guy that he made all those hits with was up there on the panel... I said, 'I didn’t say that to insult Grover.'

ctx.x: That’s Jimmy’s son, yeah, Mtume. I told Jimmy at the time, that’s why I’m anti- crossover because I feel if you have to… I was at a meeting once and Grover, rest his soul…
